시편 145:1.content: David’s Psalm of praise. I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

시편 145:2.content: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

시편 145:3.content: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

시편 145:4.content: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

시편 145:5.content: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

시편 145:6.content: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

시편 145:7.content: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

시편 145:8.content: The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

시편 145:9.content: The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

시편 145:10.content: All thy works shall praise thee, O Lord; and thy saints shall bless thee.

시편 145:11.content: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

시편 145:12.content: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

시편 145:13.content: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

시편 145:14.content: The Lord upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

시편 145:15.content: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.

시편 145:16.content: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

시편 145:17.content: The Lord is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

시편 145:18.content: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

시편 145:19.content: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

시편 145:20.content: The Lord preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

시편 145:21.content: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
